F totally real, H/F finite abelian CM, S containing infinite/ramified places, T disjoint with the stated torsion-killing condition, and p outside S union T splitting completely are all carried into DKSW Theorem 1.1. The prime-to-T unit congruences, absolute values away from p and every character valuation identity match the source.

The convention chi(Theta)=L_S,T(0,chi^-1) implies ord_(sigma^-1 P)(u) equals the sigma coefficient of Theta; Fourier inversion gives the exact P^Theta ideal relation. Complex absolute values one force u*j(u)=1, so the antiunit property follows with the correct action.

Localization kills exactly the two-primary obstruction, so an away-from-two class-group annihilation statement cannot be silently lifted integrally. If j b=-b, replacing beta by beta/j(beta) doubles the ideal exponent. The source integral theorem includes the needed stronger two-adic divisibility (and the degree-one Stickelberger case); no division by 2 without that input is made. The report does not independently establish equivalence of every unsmoothed ideal/root-extension formulation.
